content: “War ɣarreṣ ca i ufunas niɣ i yijjen zeg wuǧi i di iǧa ca n řɛib, niɣ ca n řmař iɛeffnen, i SIDI, AREBBI nnec, minzi man aya d jjɛifect i SIDI, AREBBI nnec.

Umi yufa di řwesṭ nnec, ɣar daxeř i tewwura nnec, tinni d ac iwca SIDI, AREBBI nnec, ca n weryaz niɣ ca n temɣart i iggin min iǧan d řɣar di tiṭṭawin n SIDI, AREBBI nnec, uca ammu i ɣa iɛeddu x Řɛahd nnes,
uca ad yuyur, ad iɛbed i irebbiten nneɣni uca ad asen ibendeq, i tfuct niɣ i yuyur niɣ i marra itran n ujenna, min war xef umureɣ necc,
uca yiweḍ i cek-dd řexbar uca tesřid tt, xenni ittxeṣṣa ad tt tarzud mliḥ, u xzar, mařa d tidett uca tban belli tᵉttwagg di Israil jjɛifect tanita,
xenni ad tessuffɣed aryaz nni niɣ tamɣart nni i iggin řɣar-a ɣar tewwura nnec, aryaz nni niɣ tamɣart nni, uca ad ten tḥejjared s iẓra ař ɣa mmten.”
“X wawař zeg uqemmum n tnayen niɣ třata n řechud ad ittwaneɣ wenni ittwaḥkem s řmewt. X wawař zeg uqemmum n ijj n ucehhad war iḥeǧeř ad ittwaneɣ.
Afus n řechud ad xas wḍan d amezwaru maḥend ad t nɣen uca awarni as ad xas wḍan ifassen n marra řgens. Ammu i ɣa tekksed řɣar zi řwesṭ nnec.”

“Xmi xak ɣa teqseḥ ca n tmesřact di lḥukm jar usizzeř n idammen d usizzeř n idammen nneɣni, jar ddeɛwet d ddeɛwet, jar ticti d tecti, niɣ di lḥukm deg imcubbac ɣar daxeř i tewwura nnec, xenni ad tekkared, ad tgeɛɛded ɣar wemcan nni ɣa yixḍar SIDI, AREBBI nnec.
Uca ad dd-tawḍed ɣar ikehhanen, ɣar Ilawiyyen, uca xenni ɣar řqaḍi nni din iǧan deg wussan nni, uca ad tesseqsid u nitni ad cek xebbaren x řeḥkam.
Ad tegged am tenfuč nni i cek ɣa xebbaren deg wemcan nni i ɣa yixḍar SIDI uca ad teḥḍid marra min d ac ɣa sseɛdun.
Ad tegged ɛlaḥsab awař n Ccariɛa nni d ac ɣa seccnen u ɛlaḥsab řeḥkam nni d ac ɣa inin. War ttḥeyyid x wawař i d ac ɣa inin ɣar yefus uřa ɣar uzeřmaḍ.
Aryaz nni itteggen s tuffet u war ittesři ɣar ukehhan nni i din ibedden, ḥima ad din isexxar SIDI, AREBBI nnec, niɣ war ittesři ɣar řqaḍi, aqa aryaz nni ad immet. Ittxeṣṣa ad tekksed řɣar zi Israil.
Marra řgens ittxeṣṣa asen ad sřen u ad ggʷeden u war ttuffen ɛad.”
X ujeǧid
“Xmi ɣa tadfed ɣar temmurt nni i d ac ɣa iwc SIDI, AREBBI nnec uca ad tt tᵉṭṭfed d řwart uca ad dayes tzedɣed u xenni ad tinid: ‘Ad xafi ggeɣ ijj n ujeǧid am marra řegnus i d ayi dd-innḍen!’,
xenni ad xak tegged d ajeǧid wenni i ɣa yixḍar SIDI, AREBBI nnec. Zi řwesṭ n aytmac ad tegged d ijj n ujeǧid xak, war xak ttegg ca abarrani i war iǧin ca d umac.
Maca war iḥeǧeř ad yarni iysan i ixef nnes u war ittarri ca řgens ɣar Miṣra maḥend ad yarni iysan, minzi SIDI inna awem: Zi ssa d tsawent war dd-tɛiqqibem ɛemmarṣ x webrid-a!
War ikessi ca i ixef nnes aṭṭas n temɣarin, ḥima war ittɣarri wuř nnes. War yarenni ca i yixef nnes nnuqart niɣ ureɣ s waṭṭas.
Xmi ɣa iqqim x řɛarc n tgeldit nnes, xenni ad yari i yixef nnes ict n uɛawed n tira n Ccariɛa-ya deg ijj n wedlis ittwannḍen zzat i wudem n ikehhanen, Ilawiyyen.
Ad ɣares yiři uɛawed n tira-ya, ad dayes iɣar marra ussan n tudart nnes, ḥima ad iřmed ad iggʷed SIDI, AREBBI nnes, ad iḥḍa marra awařen n Ccariɛa-ya d tweṣṣa-ya uca ad zzaysent igg,
ḥima war issiřiy uř nnes x yaytmas niɣ ad iḥeyyed x webrid n tewṣeyyet, war iǧi ɣar yefus uřa ɣar uzeřmaḍ, maḥend ad izzugart ussan n tgelda nnes, netta d warraw nnes, di řwesṭ n Israil.”
